summary: Iteration 3 — Frontend-only testing of new /explore public page and AgriFlow→AGRIOS brand rebrand. Ran 27 Playwright assertions across /, /explore, /login, /signup, /app/marketplace (buyer login), sitemap.xml, and /api/listings. 27/27 effectively pass. The one initial 'Recently on AGRIOS' inner_text miss was a false negative caused by CSS uppercase transform; raw HTML + screenshot both confirm the label and the recent-deals-feed section render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: /signup document.title is inherited from the previously-visited /explore page tab because Signup.jsx does not set its own useDocumentMeta / document.title. Verified: after navigating from an Explore card to /signup, the tab title remained 'Explore verified farm produce · AGRIOS'. Minor SEO/UX polish — Signup should set its own title e.g. 'Create your AGRIOS account · AGRIOS'.

RecentDealsFeed /api/stats/recent-deals currently surfaces TEST_-prefixed crops (e.g. 'TEST_UI_Crop') and TEST destinations ('TEST UI 1 Lagos', 'TEST_ref') in the public Landing marquee, because previous testing agents created TEST_ listings/orders that flowed to 'completed'. Consider excluding TEST_-prefixed records from the public anonymised feed, or nightly-purge TEST_ orders.

Explore card links to /signup via full Link component — good. However no referral param is passed, so SEO/attribution can't track that a signup came from /explore. Consider appending ?ref=explore or ?utm_source=explore to drive-top-of-funnel measurement.

success_rate.backend: not tested (skip per request; /api/listings spot-checked: 200, 6 items)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md — buyer@agriflow.ng / Buyer@123 login verified, AppShell brand shows AGRIOS.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything on the /explore + rebrand scope works. If retesting, note: (1) /api/stats/recent-deals surfaces lingering TEST_ records from prior iterations; (2) document.title on /signup is not overridden so it inherits from prior route — cosmetic only; (3) CSS uppercase on hero labels means inner_text returns 'RECENTLY ON AGRIOS' not 'Recently on AGRIOS' — assert via page.content() HTML or lowercase the check.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues found. Three minor code-review nits (title inheritance on /signup, TEST_ data leaking into public feed, missing attribution param on explore→signup) passed back to main agent as optional polish.
